findings.evidence: BoundaryCondition.lean:84-85 has `@[simp] theorem mem_withBoundaryIn_iff`. Higher.lean:92 has no attribute.
findings.fix: Tag `mem_higherWithBoundaryIn_iff` with `@[simp]`, and keep the `Iff.rfl` lemma `mem_higherWithBoundaryIn_iff_lowerOrdersL` without the attribute.
findings.issue: `mem_higherWithBoundaryIn_iff` is the membership characterization of `higherWithBoundaryIn` but is not `@[simp]`, while its order-one counterpart `mem_withBoundaryIn_iff` is.

findings.evidence: Bordered/Morrey.lean:244-245 has `@[simp] theorem toSection_ofContMDiffSection`. Sobolev/Basic.lean:687 has `@[simp] chartValueL_lowerOrdersL`.
findings.issue: `toSection_lowerOrdersL_ofContMDiffSection` gives the normal form of `toSection` of a smooth section, but it is not `@[simp]`, while `toSection_ofContMDiffSection` is.

findings.evidence: BoundaryCondition.lean:118 `theorem exists_mem_withBoundaryIn_toSection_eq_iff` is the order-one form that this file otherwise mirrors.
findings.fix: Add `exists_mem_higherWithBoundaryIn_toSection_eq_iff` in Higher.lean (two lines, from `mem_higherWithBoundaryIn_iff` and `toSection_lowerOrdersL_ofContMDiffSection`). Then derive `exists_mem_higherWithBoundaryIn_real_toSection_eq_const_iff` from it.
findings.issue: Missing a higher-order version of `exists_mem_withBoundaryIn_toSection_eq_iff`: a `C^{1+k}` section `s` is the representative of some element of `higherWithBoundaryIn` exactly when `∀ x ∉ borderedInterior M, s x ∈ L x`. Because of this gap, Higher/Disc.lean re-proves the ∃ direction inline (lines 64-73) and only for constant sections.

findings.evidence: Disc.lean:57 `private def trivialSection ... ⟨f, fun x ↦ (contMDiffAt_section_iff x).2 (by simpa using hf x)⟩`; Higher/Disc.lean:46-48 `private def constSection ... ⟨fun _ ↦ v, fun x ↦ (contMDiffAt_section_iff x).2 (by simpa using contMDiffAt_const)⟩`.
findings.fix: Make one constructor for all orders: generalize `trivialSection` to `Cₛ^m` for a `C^m` map and use it in both disc files. Better, state the higher-order disc result for a general `C^{1+k}` map `f`, parallel to `exists_mem_withBoundaryIn_toSection_eq_iff_of_unitClosedDisc`, and get the constant case from it.
findings.issue: The `private constSection` repeats the existing `private trivialSection` pattern from BoundaryCondition/Disc.lean:57 (a `ContMDiff` map turned into a section of the trivial bundle), now at order `m`. The disc API ends up with two hidden copies of the same packaging, and higher-order users have no general map-based disc statement.

summary: The higher-order space's API is incomplete: two lemmas that mirror `@[simp]` lemmas on main lack the attribute, and the general higher-order version of `exists_mem_withBoundaryIn_toSection_eq_iff` is missing. Without that lemma, the disc file uses a private constant-section construction and proves only the constant case.
